product.title: REJURAN Derma Healer Pore Tightening Toner Pad 220ml 60 Pads
product.body_html:
REJURAN Derma Healer Pore Tightening Toner Pad 220ml 60 Pads

Description

  • A pore-clearing, pore-converging toner pad that provides powerful skin improvement effects with DOT c-PDRN using Rejuran's patented technology. Contains Pore Clear Complex (beta-carotene, tocopherol, BHA, PHA, AHA, LHA) that clears pores to remove sebum in pores and help with pore care. Contains two types of active ingredients, Virginia Clematis extract and Cooling Agent23, to provide an immediate cooling effect on loose skin and relieve pore enlargement. A lightweight porous vegan sheet filled with high-efficiency moisture essence with a 3-Layer Delivery System that intensively delivers effective ingredients and moisture to the skin. Skin irritation test completed.

How to use

  • After washing your face, gently wipe along the skin texture with a pad and allow the essence to be absorbed. In particular, use it as a pack for areas with large pores to provide intensive care.

Ingredients

  • Purified water, dipropylene glycol, butylene glycol, glycerin, niacinamide, aloe vera leaf juice, port marigold extract, oat kernel extract, cucumber fruit extract, hydroxyacetophenone, tromethamine, polyglyceryl-10 laurate, salicylic acid, gluconolactone, caprylyl glycol, lactic acid, carbomer, 12-hexanediol, ammonium acryloyldimethyl taurate/VP copolymer, ethylhexylglycerin, xanthan gum, tocopherol, adenosine, cellulose gum, laminaria ocroleuca extract, hydrolyzed DNA, hamamelis virginiana extract, capryloyl salicylic acid, rhododendron extract, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Methyl Diisopropyl Propionamide, Dipotassium Glycyrrhizate, Canola Oil, Citric Acid, Carrot Seed Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Sunflower Seed Oil, Carrot Extract, Disodium EDTA, Beta-Carotene

Specs

  • Brand : REJURAN
  • Capacity : 220ml 60 Pads
  • Target Area : Face
  • Skin Type : All Skin Types
  • Country of origin : South Korea
